Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Ferb, what should we do today? I mean, besides giving Perry a bath.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (peeking over the fence) What is that wonderful noise?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I have got to take a new picture of myself for my blog. I didn't realize mine is already a week old. (Takes a picture of herself) That's better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: WHAT ARE YOU DOING TO MOM'S CAR?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We tricked it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't even know how to drive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, duh. That's why Ferb built this remote.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deeply) Oh, you are so busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens door) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, reenters garage) Um, where's Mom? (smiles awkwardly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's playing bridge at Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro's!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh, they won't get away with it this time!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, Candace, dear. Bubela, how good to see you. What a coincidence. Do you know your mom is here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmm-mmm. Yeah, I do, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro. I need to talk to her if you don't mind.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oy-vey. Look how tall you are now. You must've grown a couple of inches since the last time I've saw you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was last week, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Well your mom's inside, dear. Where are your braces? I thought you were wearing braces.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. MOM! MOM! MOM! (runs inside)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you have got to see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. What's the red button for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOOOOOOOOM!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it? What do you want me to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (guestures toward the boys) Quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys! (to Candace) Well, if that's all, I'll just be getting back to the game.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing we've beefed up the suspension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woah! What else can it do?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Dreamy look and voice) Hi, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're entering The Swamp Oil 500 today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aren't you gonna need a pit crew?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you know a pit crew?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well...I know a few people who work well together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! You're hired! See you at the track. (To Ferb) Hey Ferb, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons completely unknown, he's purchased a giant airship or blimp, as the kids say. Your mission is to find out why, and if necessary, put a stop to it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Dreamily) Hi, Phineas. I got your pit crew.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! See ya in the pits.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls. We're dealing with a 426 cubic inch, fully-blown V8, with hypo lifters, radical cam and a limited slip differential.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Would that be electronically fuel-injected?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?! PHINEAS! PHIN-E-AS!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! I can't hear the cars!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! I didn't know you were a racing fan!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy. (Slaps) Who, me? Oh, yeah! Yeah, I'm a big fan of those, uh, uh...that red one is cute!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, that's Billy Ray Digler's car. He's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, he's the best. That Billy Roy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Billy Ray.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Billy Ray. I-I love it when he turns left... and then he turns... left again, and then-

Name: Dave
Dialog: And in the 3rd lane, the newcomers Team Phineas! Now is it just me, or does he look a little young to be behind the wheel of a 700 horse power racing machine?

Name: Rick
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he does.

Name: Dave
Dialog: And look, he's already got his own screaming fans!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen) PHINEAS!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace is rooting for us!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you're on the big screen!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen, slow mo) PHINEAS!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And your little brother's gonna be on TV!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas--? (sees him being interviewed) On TV? (Stands up) TV! That's it! They are so busted! Can you wait here for a second? (zips off, but comes back) Thanks. (zips off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, Candace? I'm right in the middle of a 3-No trump.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on a payphone at the race) Turn on the TV!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right. All right, Candace. This better be good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) Well? Well? Do you see it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a second, honey.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Turn on the cable box first.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. All right. (Presses another remote, ejecting a CD) Wait. 'Kay, that's not it. Um, is it this one? No, this is another phone.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I turned on the stereo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cringing) Mom, hurry up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, just a second! (Presses the right remote)

Name: TV Narrator
Dialog: Are you embarrassed about flaking? Itching? Peeling?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this is a dandruff commercial. Is there something you're trying to tell me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Are we good to go?

Name: Rick
Dialog: And with the race about to start, there's the Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated blimp!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. I'm glad you're here. Actually, I was just getting ready to serve some PLATYPUS UNDER GLASS! You're just in time to witness my latest invention...my Deflate-inator Ray! Which I will demonstrate by deflating the tires of the Jefferson County Motor Speedway! After which, I will deflate everything in the Tri-State Area! That way, if anyone want's anything flated, they will have to talk to me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you are in big trouble, mister--! (Cars zoom past her, leaving her burnt)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you got a little...

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (takes picture) Smile! Souvenir picture? Only a dollar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! (shakes herself clean) Wait a second. (Grabs camera, runs off)

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Takes a picture of Phineas driving) Ee-ee-ee-ee... now, I gotcha!

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (Snatches picture) Hey, Missy. Two pictures, two bucks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, uh, I've only got a dollar, but uh, I just want the one. You can just tear the other one up, 'kay?(The photographer rips one picture)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rides out on bike) I've got 'em, NOW! Heeheehee.

Name: Rick
Dialog: And on the fast on the inside lane is Number 42, Team Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Do you think we can get any more power? I mean, I know it's just a battery. But I was thinking

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We should bring Phineas in for a pit stop. All right, Fireside Girls, let's move, move, move!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That helmet looks so manly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hit it, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm so proud of you girls. And the bow was a nice touch, Gretchen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing) Listen to those fools, as they worship their candy-colored race car man. How about a little demonstration of my deflationary prowess? (Fires laser)

Name: Man #2
Dialog: I got it! (Ball hissing, tires screeching)

Name: Race Car Driver
Dialog: AAH! (Tires screeching, rams a sign)

Name: Rick
Dialog: The Team Phineas car is avoiding every obstacle! It's like he can see the whole darn track at once!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OH YEAH!

Name: Racers
Dialog: We're okay! (Car zooms by)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well Mom, what do you think of this?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You've...looked better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What do you mean--? (looks at picture, starts to cringe)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Already they fear me, listen to their screams, huh? Imagine the mayhem once my Deflate-inator ray is fully charged. (at the mouse in the machine) Run! Run like the wind, my little indentured rodent. And I will give you some cheese. Heh, I know I had some around here somewhere.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think there's some- There used to be some Roquefort around the back here. I don't...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm? AYYY! AY-AY-AY-AYYY! (Glass breaks) Agh! Oof! (Laser fires, Blimp deflating) Hmm. I suppose I should've seen that coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) But Mom, you've gotta believe me! (cuts inside) Wait a minute. I bet it's still on TV! (runs off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Flatly) That's good, Candace. Go watch a little TV.

Name: Dave
Dialog: And look at this amazing finish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stammering) Mom, come quick! Come look-look-look-look-look!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right! I'm coming! (stands up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Dave
Dialog: Oh no! A blimp is about to hit the broadcasting tower! Oh, the hu-

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah-huh...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (leaving) Deal me back in, Viv.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Looks like we're walking.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mimicking Linda) "Why don't you go back home, Candace?" "I'm busy with my bridge game, Candace?" She has no idea!! (echo)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AHH-AHH-AHH-AHH-AHH! AAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Runs up to Vivian's house and repeatedly knocks on the door hard) MOM! MOM! MOM! MOM! MOM!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, Candace, hello. I can't believe you grown so much, it's unbelievable--

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOM! (Goes to the living room) Mom, you've gotta see this! It's about your car!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (While Candace smiles) All right. (Candace drags her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (literally pushes Linda across the street) Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you're wearing out the heels of my shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See Mom?! Look, look! I told you--

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Gasps) But...who did this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You mean...they...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overlapping) Yeah, yeah, yeah! (laughs chaotically)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overjoyed) They washed my car!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mood changing with each word) Yes!!--No--What?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's beautiful!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I gotta admit, I thought you we're exaggerating a bit, but this is really worth getting excited about!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking in the background, trophy in hand) Hi, Mom, we're home!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys! I saw what you did today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Referring to the race) Yeah, how'd you like it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I loved it! Now who wants some snacks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Thanks, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (At Candace) Honey, close your mouth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OH YEAH!
